purpose: Bind a model-authored pre-research solution baseline to durable runtime evidence before the governed profile enters research/challenger execution, without creating a second reasoning authority.

applicability.rule: Server derives mode and declarative binding contract from the canonical profile asset; caller cannot opt in/out or supply output paths.

profile_asset_contract_shape.snapshot_schema: profile-owned JSON Schema object, <=12000 serialized bytes

baseline_contract.baseline_digest: profile-owned canonical sha256 validated by the bound profile output validator
baseline_contract.server_snapshot_fingerprint: SHA256(jsonb_text(snapshot)); temporal identity/readback only, never canonical value authority

compatibility.opt_in: Set canonical profile asset metadata.research_baseline_mode=PRE_RESEARCH_ALWAYS and a PROFILE_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDING_V1 contract through governed profile reconciliation.
compatibility.rollback: Remove the profile metadata opt-in first, then revert the runtime step/function migration.
compatibility.production_apply: Migration actor must carry production_apply_authorized=true; source-candidate executions cannot satisfy the apply precondition.

dispatch_protocol.not_required: records clean N/A step and dispatches no model
dispatch_protocol.required: returns BASELINE_REQUIRED with server-derived contract and does not record the step
dispatch_protocol.required_followup: invoke the same selected profile model only to produce the compact baseline envelope, then retry the same function
dispatch_protocol.forbidden: unconditional model dispatch before server applicability result

transition.in_flight_policy: Execution policy is snapshotted at begin. Pre-migration in-flight executions without research_baseline_mode are treated as NOT_REQUIRED.
transition.compatibility_backfill: After installing the new step contract, the migration calls the canonical baseline function with null envelope for each in-flight NOT_REQUIRED execution whose context_admission is already clean.
transition.required_mode_inflight: Fail migration if any pre-existing in-flight execution already claims PRE_RESEARCH_ALWAYS; no retroactive required baseline is fabricated.
